newsitem.title: CANADA: Alberta seeds 35 pct of crops, ahead of 10-yr avg.
newsitem.headline: Alberta seeds 35 pct of crops, ahead of 10-yr avg.

text.p: Alberta farmers seeded 35 percent of spring crops by Monday ahead of 18 percent over the 10-year average for the same date, Alberta Wheat Pool said in its weekly crop report.
Seeding was 15 percent complete at the same time last year and 20 percent complete in the five-year average, AWP said.
Normal spring weather helped spring harvest and seeding activities throughout the province and northeastern British Columbia in the past week with farmers active in all regions.
Soil moisture declined compared to the prior week with additional moisture required in many southern districts.

The Brooks-Lethbridge district in the south had seeded the most acreage with 87 percent of crops planted, followed by the southeastern district of Medicine Hat-Foremost at 84 percent then Clareshold-Cardston district, also in the south, at 59 percent seeded.
The southern Peace River district had the least crop planted with only one percent seeded.
Eighty one percent of winter wheat and fall rye survived the winter, AWP said.
